source:
@@U04065@@
(Young, lightly armed, brightly dressed.)

@@U04066@@
One crooked look at me You've got a fist in the kisser. Some yellow-belly flees, He gets it in the pisser.

@@U04068@@
(Mature, well armed, richly dressed.)

@@U04069@@
Empty brawls, who needs ’em? Learn to put first things first: Siege, pillage, and plunder— When thirsty quench your thirst.

@@U04071@@
(Old, heavily armed, scantily clothed.)

@@U04072@@
Not much profit there! You win first, then it’s gone, Time's taken it in pawn. Down life’s stream it flows, You watch it as it goes. To get is good, you bet! But to keep is better yet. Take an old man’s word Anything else is absurd.

@@U04073@@
(They descend to the valley together.)

@@U04075@@
Drums and martial music from below. The EMPEROR: tent is being pitched. EMPEROR. COMMANDER-IN-CHIEE BODYGUARDS.

@@U04077@@
It was wise, I think, to withdraw the whole army into this valley. I’m confident we'll be successful.
translation:
@@U04065@@
（年轻，轻装，衣着鲜艳。）

@@U04066@@
斜视着我，你在接吻时握着拳头。一些黄腹鱼逃跑了，他把它弄进了小便器里。

@@U04068@@
（成熟、武装精良、衣着华丽。）

@@U04069@@
空洞的争吵，谁需要它们？学会以要事为先：围攻、掠夺、掠夺——渴了就解渴。

@@U04071@@
（年老，全副武装，衣着暴露。）

@@U04072@@
那里利润不多啊！你先赢了，然后它就消失了，时间把它当作了棋子。它顺着生命的河流流淌，你看着它流淌。得到就很好，你敢打赌！但保留更好。听听老人的话，其他的都是荒谬的。

@@U04073@@
（他们一起下到山谷。）

@@U04075@@
从下面传来鼓声和军乐。皇帝：正在搭帐篷。皇帝。总司令保镖。

@@U04077@@
我认为，将全军撤回这个山谷是明智的。我相信我们会成功。
